howToEdit: One entry per card. "card" is rank + suit: A 2-10 J Q K, then D (diamonds), C (clubs), H (hearts), S (spades). Do not change it.
label: the short name under the card. Leave blank to show the card name, e.g. "Seven of Clubs".
meaning: one sentence shown in the strip when the card is lifted. Leave blank to show "Meaning to come."
image: the file name in public/cards/, e.g. "7c.png". Leave blank to show the "Art coming" face.
alt: what the illustration shows, for screen readers, e.g. "Seven of Clubs: a brass lamp". Leave blank to use the card name.
Wrap words in *asterisks* for italics, e.g. "*Saat phere*". Type & and quotes as normal text.
